verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows a live, structured llms.txt index at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/llms.txt. Doc pages are served as raw markdown (.md) with `agentTools: projectIndex` frontmatter pointing back to llms.txt, and the OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema can be retrieved without authentication. Together these give an agent a direct, machine-readable path into the docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no first-party guidance describing agent-oriented docs usage.
